question: Pritzker Prize is commonly known as the Nobel Prize given for the field of _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**architecture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pritzker Prize **is given for its outstanding contribution to the field of ** Architecture **it is also known as the **Noble Prize of Architecture.**
 
• It was initiated by** Jay A Pritzker with his wife Cindy in 1979** residents of **Chicago** are known for their support in educational, medical, and cultural activities.
 
• The award was sponsored by** Hyatt Foundation**.
 
• The Pritzker Architecture Prize is said to be awarded irrespective of nationality, race, creed, or ideology.
 
• Laureates of the **Pritzker Architecture Prize receive a $100,000 grant, a formal citation certificate, and a bronze medallion**.
 
• The designs on the medal are inspired by the work of architect** Louis Sullivan.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **B. V. Doshi is the only Indian Architect** who won Pritzker Prize in 2018, he built many famous buildings like **IIM Banglore, IIM Udaipur, National Institute of Fashion Technology, New Delhi.**
 
• **Pritzker Prize of 2022** is won by **Diébédo Francis Kéré.**
 
• **The Abel Prize by Norwighein Government is known as the Noble Prize of Maths**.
